experiments.paper_location: Released MONGOOSE-SLIDE SimHash sign packing and native LSH support; no new paper theorem
experiments.mechanism: Execute shared SYCL projection and int32 packed sign codes on a real CPU device, then pass actual codes into the maintained native LSH table.

conditions.execution: Actual AdaptiveCpp generic/OpenMP SYCL CPU selector; multiple work-items; no serial C++ fallback
conditions.domain: contiguous finite FP32 data[N,d], weights[d,kL]; positive N/d/L; k1..32; int32 bits with zero false and optional transpose
conditions.oracle: Literal9/6/0/15 codes, independent FP64 scalar projection and power-of-two packing, actual maintained LSH.cpp with independent bucket union expectations
conditions.maintained_fallback: Separate tests/fallback.py checks existing Torch CPU implementation, not original CUDA
conditions.original_cuda: Exact unchanged body plus standard pcuda.hpp compile probe fails at __shfl_down_sync; original body never executed
conditions.legacy: Unused production matrix_simhash helper int64 API explicitly excluded; no legacy execution claim
conditions.identity: validate.py captures candidate/source/fixture/binary hashes and device/runtime log; shared toolchain records compiler

experiments.note: New SYCL rewrite evidence only. Existing CPU fallback/native/Cython IDs retain their original meanings. CuPy/PyNVRTC/current-stream/shuffle semantics remain outside this CPU result; see ports/mongoose/sycl/SYCL_CONTRACT.md and Issue121.
